intent.task intent: Audit findings: 22. Parent: the Swarm Design System keeps ledger, quota routing, herdr and durable agent coordination; this audit phase makes its presentation accessible and its cost proportional to changed resources. Expand API beside old routes, using the repository interface. Define API v1 collection and item resources for ledger summaries and metadata, tasks, phases, questions, followups, notes and their threads, chat, priorities, notifications, artifacts, bin and swarm control readers. Reuse domain operations instead of creating independent semantics. Provide bounded pagination, per resource revisions, stable machine readable error envelopes and request schemas validated centrally with a real declared schema dependency if needed. Migrate CLI and tick clients to resource operations and guarded updates, with operation ids and expected revisions preserved. Large explicit export stays a named operation; routine reads and writes return bounded resources or acknowledgments, not the whole record. Keep bearer values out of logs; preserve host, origin, token, identity and role checks. Seams: schema rejection without mutation, forbidden caller, revision conflict, retry idempotency, resource read and operator inbox delivery. Done when: Every current client operation has a schema validated v1 route with bounded replies and equivalent authorization. One PR into dev, gates green, Standards and Spec reviews closed, merged; record SHA and CI run.
